title: Learn DevOps
tagline: From scripts on a laptop to pipelines that ship safely
description: A three-level curriculum for getting code from a developer's machine to production — Linux and cloud basics, then containers and CI/CD, then infrastructure as code, environments, and the monitoring that makes frequent deploys survivable.
prerequisites: Comfort with a terminal and Git
Programming fundamentals in any language (Bash or Python help immediately)
Willingness to use a cloud account (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with billing alerts on

levels.title: Linux, Networks & Cloud Fundamentals
levels.goal: Operate a Linux box, explain a request path, and use one cloud provider without guessing

topics.title: Linux administration
items: Users, permissions, processes, and systemd at a working level
Filesystems, logs under /var/log, and journalctl
Packages, SSH, and not SSHing as root for daily work

topics.title: Shell scripting
items: Bash: variables, pipes, exit codes, and set -euo pipefail
Idempotent scripts vs. one-off copy-paste
Python for glue when Bash gets brittle

topics.title: Networking basics
items: DNS, DNS records, and TLS certificates at a conceptual level
HTTP vs. HTTPS, ports, and reverse proxies
Load balancers vs. a single VM

topics.title: Git workflows
items: Trunk, feature branches, and protected main
What belongs in git vs. secrets managers
Reviewing a Dockerfile or workflow file like application code

topics.title: One cloud, end to end
items: Compute, object storage, and a managed database
IAM users vs. roles; never commit long-lived keys
Billing alarms before the first experiment

projects: Provision a VM, SSH in, and serve a static site behind HTTPS
Bash or Python script that bootstraps a repeatable server setup
Architecture sketch: DNS → load balancer → app → database

levels.title: CI/CD, Containers & Environments
levels.goal: Containerize an app and ship it through a pipeline to more than one environment

topics.title: Docker fundamentals
items: Images, layers, and multi-stage builds
Non-root users, .dockerignore, and pin versions
Compose for local dependencies (app + Postgres + Redis)

topics.title: Registries and promotion
items: Tagging by git SHA, not only latest
Pushing to GHCR, ECR, or equivalent
Scanning images for known CVEs at a working level

topics.title: Pipeline design
items: GitHub Actions or Jenkins: lint, test, build, deploy
OIDC to cloud instead of static access keys
Required checks on pull requests

topics.title: Environment management
items: Dev, staging, prod as separate accounts or namespaces
Config and secrets per environment
Manual approval for production when the risk is real

topics.title: Workloads you will actually use
items: Pods, Deployments, Services, and ConfigMaps/Secrets
Rollouts, rollbacks, and readiness/liveness probes
kubectl debugging: logs, describe, and exec

topics.title: Safe deploys
items: Blue/green or rolling updates conceptually
Database migrations ordered before or after the app
A rollback you can run without the original author

projects: Containerize an existing API and run it with Compose
GitHub Actions pipeline: test → image → deploy to staging
Kubernetes Deployment + Service for that image with a rollback documented

levels.title: Infrastructure, Reliability & Hardening
levels.goal: Manage infra as code, watch it, and respond when a deploy is the incident

topics.title: Terraform in practice
items: Modules, state backends, and locking
Plan in CI; apply with a recorded change
Secrets: never in state you treat as public

topics.title: Networks and identity
items: VPC/VNet, subnets, and security groups as code
Least-privilege IAM for pipelines and workloads
Private databases; public only what must be public

topics.title: Prometheus and Grafana
items: Metrics that map to user pain (latency, errors, saturation)
Dashboards per service and per pipeline
Alerts with runbooks, not pages for every blip

topics.title: On-call basics
items: Severity, communication, and who owns the rollback
Post-deploy checks that catch bad releases fast
Change windows vs. continuous delivery trade-offs

topics.title: Security hardening
items: Image and base OS patching cadence
Network policies and secrets rotation
Supply chain: lockfiles, signed images, and least-privilege runners

topics.title: Many services, one path
items: Reusable workflow templates for app teams
Environment promotion that finance and audit can follow
Cost tags on every resource the pipeline creates

projects: Terraform a VPC, database, and app runtime; apply via CI
Production-like pipeline with staging gates and a rollback runbook
Prometheus/Grafana dashboards and alerts for a sample API
SACCO/fintech-style env split: isolated prod account, tagged costs, signed images
